products.body:
Celebrate 15 Years of Fallout: New Vegas

Welcome back to New Vegas and enjoy your stay with this 15th Anniversary Bundle. A must-have for every Courier. The anniversary set combines iconic memorabilia from the Mojave Wasteland with the Ultimate Edition of the game.

Explore vast expanses of desert wastelands from small towns to the New Vegas Strip. Choose sides in the upcoming war and forever change the lives of New Vegas inhabitants. Enjoy finely tuned real-time combat mechanics with the V.A.T.S. targeting system, Hardcore mode, and streamlined companion commands. In a huge, open world with unlimited options, you can see the sights, choose sides, or go it alone.

Joined by Victor the Securitron, the 15th Anniversary Bundle will bring the spirit of this desert oasis right to your home.

FEATURES

  • Victor Statue (8" PVC): The friendly Securitron stands tall and ready to roll.
  • Doc Mitchell’s Evaluation Cards (7x7 cardstock set): Straight from your first moments in Goodsprings, a true piece of New Vegas history.
  • Vault Boy Enamel Pin (1.5"): Vault Boy stacks the odds with poker chips in hand.
  • Mojave Express Patch (3.5" × 1.9"): Woven, iron-on, and full of wasteland charm.
  • NCR Recon Patch (3.25" × 3.5"): Woven, iron-on insignia of the New California Republic’s finest.
  • Fallout: New Vegas Ultimate Edition: Includes the full game PC digital code plus:
    • Dead Money DLC
    • Honest Hearts DLC
    • Old World Blues DLC
    • Lonesome Road DLC
    • Courier’s Stash Weapon Pack
    • Gun Runner’s Arsenal Weapon Pack
  • Collector’s Big Box: A throwback-style display box created exclusively for the anniversary.
  • Pre-order launch date: October 23, 2025
  • Bundle will ship in June 2026, Game codes for PC will be e-mailed at the same time.

Fully Functional, Wearable, Supremely Accurate and Exhibition-Grade

The first ever fully functional, supremely accurate, wearable 1:1 replica of the Pip-Boy 3000 as used in Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas.

The Pip-Boy 3000 Replica has a highly detailed and beautifully finished die-cast metal front casing, an engineered injection-moulded ABS body, and a memory foam cuff, all coming together to present the user with the most perfect balance of authentic materials.

Created by The Wand Company using the game geometry, this gorgeous replica has a functioning in-plane switching (IPS) LCD screen showing almost all of the in-game content. It is also a working timepiece with an alarm clock function – ideal for when it is sitting neatly on its perfectly-formed display stand.

Not only fully functional, but wearable, and exhibition-grade displayable, this has to be the ultimate replica collectible.

FEATURES

  • The first ever fully functional Pip-Boy 3000 Replica from Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas
  • Developed using in-game geometry, this fully-functional replica includes almost all of the in-game content from Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas

  • The most perfect balance of authentic materials - highly detailed and beautifully finished die-cast metal front casing, engineered injection-moulded ABS body, and a memory foam cuff
  • For the very first time, fans can play the Atomic Command minigame directly on their Pip-Boy 3000 Replica
  • The elegant solid machined metal stand displays the Pip-Boy perfectly and also allows it to be used as an awesome desk or nightstand clock

  • Fully functional, but wearable, and exhibition-grade displayable, this has to be the ultimate replica collectible

  • Product color may vary from images shown due to screen display variance. 

DETAILS

  • Item Dimensions: 178 mm x 130 mm x 130 mm
  • Item Weight: 724 g
  • Merchandising Box Dimensions: 223 mm x 204 mm x 153 mm
  • Merchandising Box + Product Weight: 931 g
  • Merchandising Box Specification: Expanded polypropylene (EPP) with paper label
  • Mailer Dimensions: 240 mm x 220 mm x 180 mm
  • Mailer + Merchandising Box + Product Weight: 1.21 kg (1207g)
  • Merchandising Box Contents: Die-cast and resin fully functional Pip-Boy 3000 replica, solid aluminium machined metal display stand, user manual, USB-C charging cable, FM radio external antenna cable, spacer bar for increasing cuff diameter to fit multiple arm sizes, and a RobCo hex tool
  • Battery Requirements: Rechargeable LiPo power cell, USB-C cable included
  • Age range: Suitable for ages 14+

products.body:
Does your diner serve Nuka?

Once upon a time, before the end of the world, people didn’t worry about fighting raiders or turning into ghouls. All they had in mind was the latest nuclear innovation, and what exciting new flavor Nuka-Cola is coming up with next. Little did they know that life as they knew it would come to a sudden halt. But at least for the moment, all they had was bliss. Relive that bliss by dressing your place up like an old-fashioned diner that serves America’s favorite fizzy drink. This is the Fallout® Enjoy Nuka-Cola LED Wall Art. 

FEATURES

  • Light-up sign of Nuka-Cola’s bottle cap
  • LED white and red lighting hose with colored light
  • Printed acrylic board
  • Printed cap color
  • Resin covers in red and white
  • Includes one set of wall mounting hardware 
  • Size
    • Length: 14.6 in (37.2 cm)
    • Height: 14.6 in (37.2 cm)
    • Depth: ﻿0.5 in (1.3 cm) 
  • User manual included

products.body:
Plan Your Expedition

No terrain is too dangerous nor mountain pass too narrow for the Whiteout Snowtrack Fusion Flea. It’s time to plan your expedition if you wish to acquire this prized military asset. The Whiteout Snowtrack Fusion Flea is fully winterized with rear snow track and steerable front skids.

So what are you waiting for? It’ll be all you’ll ever need to take the snowline and crest the summit in a convincing show of diesel fusion power.

FEATURES

  • Whiteout Snowtrack styled special edition
  • Early Bird Bethesda Gear Exclusive
  • Flea postcard, and fabric patch
  • Premium die-cast quality
  • Same high-quality metallic paint as the classic Fusion Flea with authentic white winter camouflage livery
  • Spare oxygen tanks and a shortwave radio model the complete the package

  • Matte Camo Paint: Multiple layers of grey and white
  • De-chromed: brightwork redacted to merge with the showscape
  • Die-cast: The all-metal body gives this Flea some real heft
  • Collectible accessories: Cold-front postcard and military fabric patch
  • Opening Canopy: Inner detail of cockpit revealed
  • Opening Engine Hood: Engine lights up with nuclear glow when the hood is opened
  • Removable Nuclear Core: Glow-in-the-dark core, glows green when ‘charged’ with a bright light
  • Attention to Detail: Each detail of Bethesda’s natty Fusion Flea design has been carefully replicated; extra areas of detail never before revealed show the workings of the compact nuclear engine and the steering and suspension geometry
  • Quality Materials: With real heft and built to last, the Whiteout Snowtrack Flea is a high-quality die-cast replica; white detailing, rubber caterpillar track, as well as tinted water-clear resin parts, come together to create a beautiful display-grade piece fit to grace any collection
  • The Ultimate Collectible: Replicating the commemorative military campaign give-away for those highly commended snowfield combatants, the Whiteout Snowtrack Flea comes complete with postcard and military fabric patch
  • The Fantasy Made Real: Iconic Fusion Fleas litter Fallout’s landscape, but before the war, Fusion Fleas’ neat little nuclear engines hummed on every frontline as they took a generation to war, work, and R&R in style.

  • Product color may vary from images shown due to screen display variance. 

Small but mighty, the Snowtrack Flea takes it all in its stride. Another steep escarpment with multiple hazards to overcome a crevasse to negotiate, nothing phases this little militarised bundle of whiteout power.
Dig-in or run ahead of the avalanche, skirt the glacier or take the ridge, this nippy little single seater is sure to guarantee success. The diecast body, covered in a complex geometric camouflage of white and grey, hides you from the enemy as you hunker down behind that low-profile tinted windshield. Oxygen tanks and a shortwave radio set, securely strapped to the flea’s tail ensure that even when cut off from your unit, you have everything you need to survive. The twin steerable skids and muscular rear caterpillar track are there to reassure you that this is the real deal, as you study the detail of the Wand Company’s all-new Whiteout Snowtrack Fusion Flea, commemorating super Flea hotrodders and military customisers everywhere. This highly detailed collectible prop replica of Chryslus’s Fusion Flea variant, hotrodded to be fully snow-capable, has been carefully fabricated from a mix of thickly painted die-cast metal, engineering plastics, and thermoplastic rubber, to give a truly awesome display-grade collectible.
Designed to replicate the specially created promotional vehicles occasionally given away as prizes for exceptional customisers’ ultimate concours conversions, this latest Flea comes complete with a cold front postcard and military fabric patch.
Lift the engine hood and see the nuclear glow still shining from the engine bay all these years later.

Bottle raised high. Rocket at the ready. Nuka-Girl is clear for launch.


Bottle raised high. Rocket at the ready. Nuka-Girl is clear for launch. Here, she proves that the only thing more powerful than atomic propulsion is the crisp, refreshing taste of Nuka-Cola.

The Fallout™ Nuka-Girl Rocketsuit Statue captures the likeness of its namesake character leaning against a rocket. She’s holding her helmet against her hip, while her right hand raises a bottle of Nuka-Cola. A blanket of billowing smoke covers the surface of the statue’s bottlecap-shaped base.
Beautifully-detailed and standing 12.8” (32.51 cm) tall, this collectible is sure to command a lot of attention wherever you display it.

FEATURES

  • Material: ABS + PVC
  • Size: 1/6 scale figure
  • Height: 12.8” (32.51 cm) total from bottom of base to top of rocket
